key.name: desktop-back
key.description: Used when the pointer is on the empty desktop, the overview or the app grid. 'none' falls back to the shell action.

key.name: desktop-forward
key.description: Used when the pointer is on the empty desktop, the overview or the app grid. 'none' falls back to the shell action.

key.name: shell-back
key.summary: Action for the back button (shell surfaces)
key.description: Used when the pointer is over a Shell surface such as the top bar. 'none' leaves the button alone. Presses over application windows never reach the extension.

key.name: shell-forward
key.summary: Action for the forward button (shell surfaces)
key.description: Used when the pointer is over a Shell surface such as the top bar. 'none' leaves the button alone. Presses over application windows never reach the extension.

key.name: work-in-overview
key.description: Run the Back and Forward actions also while the overview is open.

key.name: work-in-app-grid
key.description: Run the Back and Forward actions also while the app grid is showing.

key.name: wrap-workspaces
key.description: Previous on the first workspace goes to the last one, and next on the last goes to the first. Also applies to moving a window. Does not apply to app grid pages.

key.name: debug-log
key.description: For troubleshooting: write one debug line per Back or Forward press to the journal.
